title: The Quiet Orbit Revisited
author: Dominic Okafor
blurb: Oscar Quintana, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the fleet's truce expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
